body.p: Application No. 17/921,807 Reply to Notice of Allowance dated February 18, 2025 Amendment dated February 18, 2025

Claim 21 is amended herein in accordance with 37 C.F.R. §1.312 to correct an inadvertent error in the claim. Specifically, claim 21 is amended to change the dependency from claim 13 to claim 14, consistent with the Amendment filed January 29, 2025 wherein claim 13 was cancelled in favor of rewriting claim 14 in independent form. Claim 21 is also amended for correct antecedent basis in the claim language. Applicant asserts that this amendment merely corrects informal matters in the claims and does not change the scope of the claims.

Applicant does not believe that any fees are due in connection with this submission. However, if any additional fees are necessary to complete this communication, the Commissioner may consider this to be a request for such and charge any necessary fees to Deposit Account No. 60-1582.
Respectfully submitted, DORTON & WILLIS, LLPBy: /David W. Dorton/David W. Dorton, Reg. No. 51,6259545 Kenwood RoadSuite 202
